definition: A person who studies at a school.
A person who teaches a subject at a school.
A person who leads a school.
A group of people or an institution.
An educational institution where students study and teachers teach.
A group of students who share an activity.
Something that takes place at a given time and place, such as a fair.
A physical location, such as a building or a room.
A room equipped for scientific work.
A piece of work built by a team, such as a machine or a car.
A prize given to recognize work.
